lesson.title: 6.12 The train is late
lesson.unit_outcome: Ask whether a place is near, say how people go to work and why they go somewhere, find a platform or gate, pack for a trip, find places on a street, follow and ask for directions, ask permission, buy tickets, understand delays and check in at a hotel.
lesson.goal: Say whether a person, a bus or a train is late, on time or early, and ask Is it on time? (The train is late. Is Ana late? No, she's on time.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 6.12 What Time Does It Leave?: A1 reads departure and arrival times; A1+ 6.12 says how a trip went against the time, without clocks. The new items are late, on time and early after be (Luis is late.), with 3.4's short answers (Is Ana late? No, she's on time.). Each photo shows it in the action, not on a clock: Luis runs after a bus that is leaving, Ana walks to a train waiting with its door open, Diego reads alone at an empty gate with no airplane yet, and travelers wait by empty tracks.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 6.12 leaves and arrives; A1+ 3.4 short answers; A1+ 6.4 gate and platform.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say on TIME as two words with the stress on time; EAR-ly. Do not require native-like speed.
